subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should the next step be a canonical current-main four-agent Telegram reproduction, or should maintainers first choose a narrower owner boundary for Telegram concurrency, provider transport, launch defaults, or run-budget policy?
rationale: The remaining report crosses channel ingress, model fallback, provider transport, launch environment, and config/default surfaces; source inspection shows partial mitigations but not enough proof to pick a safe implementation path automatically.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a current-main four-agent Telegram trace before choosing any code or default change.

options.title: Split a narrower owner issue
options.body: Move remaining work to a maintainer-selected Telegram, provider transport, or runtime timeout issue if the current report is too broad to implement directly.

options.title: Close only after proof
options.body: Treat merged fallback mitigations as sufficient only if a current-main run shows the original simultaneous timeout pattern no longer occurs.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a current-main four-agent Telegram trace before choosing any code or default change.
